text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"continuous English letter with only occasional errors","quality":"control of standard English","description":"This captures more consistent use of English grammar and vocabulary with fewer breakdowns into nonstandard or mixed-language writing."},{"evidence":"clear school-menu argument from start to finish","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures maintaining a recognizable main point and developing it in a way that stays on topic throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"because... and... instead of... if...","quality":"sentence organization","description":"This captures better control of clause linking and sentence flow, even though the sentences are still error-filled."},{"evidence":"student would like... others would not like... but most...","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures giving a more developed explanation with some contrast and support rather than disconnected statements."},{"evidence":"Dear principal i am writhing this letter","quality":"task-appropriate register","description":"This captures using a form and tone that fit a school letter more closely than the other essay's mixed narrative and reflective passages."}]}
